title: Zero Single-Use Plastic Day
description: Go the entire day without using any single-use plastic items — including bags, straws, bottles, and packaging. Plan your meals and shopping in advance to make this easier.

title: 5-Minute Shorter Shower
description: Shorten today's shower by at least 5 minutes compared to your usual time. Set a timer on your phone. This simple habit saves approximately 40 litres of water per shower.

title: Walk or Cycle Instead of Drive
description: For any journey under 3 km today, choose to walk or cycle instead of using a car or motorbike. Reduces CO₂ emissions while improving your health.

title: Meatless Monday
description: Skip meat for all of today's meals. Choosing a plant-based diet even one day a week can save up to 1.5 kg of CO₂ emissions — equivalent to driving 10 km.

title: Unplug All Standby Devices
description: Before bed tonight, unplug every device that is not in active use — TVs, chargers, microwaves, and desktop computers. Prevents phantom energy drain overnight.

title: Carry a Reusable Bag Today
description: Take a reusable shopping or tote bag with you everywhere today. Refuse plastic bags at every checkout and purchase point you visit.

title: Recycle 5 Items Correctly
description: Sort and correctly dispose of at least 5 household items into the right recycling stream today. Check that they are clean and dry before placing in the bin.

title: Start a Home Compost
description: Set up a compost bin or kitchen caddy this week and begin collecting food scraps. By end of week you should have your first batch of organic matter breaking down.

title: 7-Day Eco Shopping Audit
description: Track every purchase you make this week and flag which items had unnecessary packaging or non-eco alternatives. At the end of the week, commit to 3 swaps you will make permanently.

title: Plant a Tree or Herb
description: Plant at least one tree, shrub, or herb plant this week — either in your garden, a pot, or as part of a community planting initiative. Document it with a photo.
